newsitem.title: VATICAN: Pope urges solidarity during Lent season.
newsitem.headline: Pope urges solidarity during Lent season.

text.p: Pope John Paul urged the world's 960 million Roman Catholics to show solidarity with those less fortunate, especially the homeless, during Lent which began on Wednesday.

The Pope, speaking at his weekly general audience at the Vatican, said the 40-day Lenten season "is the time of solidarity towards those individuals and people who find themselves in precarious situations in many parts of the world".
"Among those situations to which I have called particular attention is the dramatic plight of the homeless," he added.
During the season, which leads up to Easter, Christians traditionally fast and repent for their sins.

The 76-year-old Pope, who had cancelled his general audience last week because of a bout of 'flu, was scheduled to hold his traditional Ash Wednesday service later in the day at the church of Santa Sabina on Rome's Aventine hill.
